notes.title: My Dream Setup Free Placement Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/7f245bae7aec49e84d0acdac909960bbef97b665.png"][/img]The Free Placement Update for MDS is now live! This update brings two powerful new features that give you full control over your creativity:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/8b302445edfc7659be6cd0d31786920996c65990.png"][/img][/p][h2]Global No-Collision Mode[/h2][p]
No more tedious switching—collision avoidance at the click of a button!

With the new global collision avoidance mode, you no longer need to manually enable collision avoidance for each individual object. Just press a single button, and all objects in your scene will instantly stop taking collisions into account.

[/p][h2]Global Free Placement Mode[/h2][p]
Place objects on any surface—even outside the room. Want a stairs leading to your house? A sofa floating in midair? Now you can. New tools give you complete freedom and control over the placement of each object. Whether you're aiming for realism or creating something surreal, we're confident you'll discover countless ways to push the boundaries of what's possible. Unleash your creativity and create smart, cozy, or completely chaotic setups. The only rule is that there are no rules.

[/p][h3]Other Changes and Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Attaching an object to another object no longer causes crashes or unexpected behavior of floating objects[/p][/*][*][p]The “Hide internal walls” button now has a visual indication of its active state.[/p][p]

It's been a long road to this update. But now a year and a half later, we can proudly say that My Dream Setup has gone beyond just creating your dream room. Now you can create the house of your dreams. A lot of work and updates have been done to make this possible (L-shapes, Bigger blueprint, Kitchen and Bathroom, new Widnows and Door system and others). And all this thanks to a huge amount of your feedback, reviews and comments. 

[h2]Inner Walls[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/1e48a3f548df89ad2f19c1c09c412ba35191b86a.gif[/img]

Now you can put up the inner walls. Now you will be able to put up the inner walls. No more “Room shape should be closed”. You are free to build any shape, any number of interior walls, paint them, hide and reveal them, all just like with regular walls.

[h2]New Floor Painting System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/16a671e5d9bbca07afb68ca8516cf910a5ddac5b.gif[/img]

Since you can now create separate rooms, we just couldn't pass up adding this feature. The floor can now be colored in the same way as the walls. This will allow you to make different floor finishes in different rooms.

[h2]Auto Save[/h2]

It will no longer happen that you will lose in-game progress due to some unforeseen circumstances, be it a blackout, computer shut down or any other reason. Progress will now be saved every 10 minutes.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[*] All scrollbars now have proper round sprite
[*] We have moderated the Workshop. We have tried to check all items to remove items that do not work and do not comply with the community rules. Using the workshop should now become much easier.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

This time around, we're focusing on problems you've often encountered. These problems have been fixed:

[*] Fixed incorrect of rain/snow on some windows

[*] Fixed an issue that caused walls to not animate when the camera was raised
[*] Fixed incorrect behavior of one of the monitors when applying a custom image

My Dream Setup will be 1 year old very soon (February 20). We would like to thank you for the huge amount of your feedback, reviews and comments. It motivates us a lot to make more and more updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/5a5a9425c12c9c088d6e999896752849f370c41c.png[/img]

In this update, we have improved Blueprint. Now your rooms can be even bigger. We also added a separate button to remove all furniture. Another new feature is that when you click to delete all furniture or an entire room, a confirmation window will appear. We did this to avoid accidental deletion of a room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/0067bc4ca07c2a602929003442ac9c5c16bf4e46.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/ca98a8aa26166fdd51a6e9e4f027e6030ea845e4.png[/img]
We are pleased to bring you a new update that implements many long-awaited features. 

[h1]L-Shapes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/98d8254b964aaef434b15b8e18f6343df181aa8c.png[/img]

With this latest release, we are introducing the ability to create rooms of all shapes and sizes, providing you with a truly customizable and immersive experience. No more restrictions, let your imagination run free!

[h1]Customizable views from windows[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/d5dc740c83f726320afb6d227d68011aed10f81a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161354/f85baa0524106e91dd6096322380e19a62041cd7.png[/img]

[h2]Workshop transparency support[/h2]

You can now load transparent materials into the workshop. Name the material, for example TRANSPARENT_050, to make it transparent. The number after TRANSPARENT is the alpha value. 

[b]Incorrect naming: [strike]TRANSPARENT_50, TRANSPARENT_0, transparent50[/strike][/b]
[b]Correct naming: TRANSPARENT_020, TRANSPARENT_100, TRANSPARENT_000[/b]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Incorrect snow lighting fixed
[*] Placing outside of the room fixed
[/list]
